title: THE POMEGRANATE HOUR, 3 AM · The tape of the town
venue: the motel · the lobby TV at 3 AM · recaps never run · Box 13
logline: The host plays a tape recorded, she says, on a coast — surf, a gull, a bell, a whistle — and the strip draws each sound as its shape rising from the deck: the gull's two strokes, the bell's jagged, the whistle's long jagged. The last one Wood hasn't drawn since he was fourteen. He draws it now, on the pad, exactly.

panels.composition: The TV: the host pressing play; from the deck, a surf line's shape rising.
